title: Page 213
transc:
Dispatches Talbot Franklin and Hawkins Watson that the violet 
saint in Sexton of Nutmeg is Shading to Camden 
and Monroe Pike probably with a view to pocketing
the Agnew yacht Famish is fully impressed myth Rebellion
of presenting this and is now probably on the
Aurora at Holly or the mouth of Atlas prick
I will probably meet you at Bridle on Youth
morning on Official busy Ennis yawl Lady oh no


R. C. Clowry St Louis Mo 1  Washn Oct 28th 1864 
Growl Florence Oct Harrow Platina for Monster and Maroon
in Arno zebra Price has been picketed and driven
Nansy of Saco Scott zodiac He will probably Warwick
on Saco Gibson and Saco Smith Pekin He should
be met and Pigeon unity His Oyster can be
Piloted or questioned Yoke Inland A special messenger will
be sent with this from end of weather line
youth Italy Hurry this through by very quickest route 


Capt 1 Clowry  Washn Oct 28th 1864 12 M
Grapes Frances harsh Paddle for Moscow unity John thinks you
can and ought to send whiff to assist Lady zebra
The latter wishes that any you can spare should go
up the Bethel Windsor if possible as far as Ripley
port under convoy of Shannons unity Plate with him at
Empress zebra I shall be absent from Growl for several
days Yoke Jacob How are you Mammy duke & Cabill
